mainEntity.name: How long is each BabeFit Program class?

acceptedAnswer.text: While the exact duration can vary slightly, BabeFit Program classes are typically designed to be approximately one hour long. This includes time for a warm-up, the main workout, and a cool-down period. This timing allows participants to integrate fitness effectively into their schedules without requiring excessive time commitment, which can be a practical tradeoff for busy individuals.
